items.testimonial: Anaclet provided us with professional and reliable financial advisory and internal audit support. Their work helped us identify gaps in our financial management, strengthen internal controls, improve record-keeping and enhance our financial reporting processes. We appreciated their professionalism, confidentiality, analytical approach and commitment to understanding our organizational needs. We would recommend AELFC Ltd to organizations seeking practical legal, financial and audit advisory services.
